info.title: домщенков.рф API
info.description: Заявки, контакты и события сайта домщенков.рф. Публичная часть — для форм сайта; /admin — для внутренней админ-панели (Bearer-токен). Ошибки: {"error": {"code", "message", "fields": {<поле>: <текст>}}}.

post.description: A request from any form of the site. Only name, phone, contact and consent can fail validation.

200.description: Повтор уже принятой заявки (тот же idempotency_key)

post.description: Beacons (navigator.sendBeacon sends text/plain). Always 202: tracking must never bother a page.

get.description: For an uptime monitor: 200 {"ok": true} or 503 {"ok": false}. Details: GET /api/v1/admin/health.

Statuses, kinds, channels, reasons with Russian labels and colours; breeds (with their SQL view names);
managers. The panel should take every label from here.

The one big base; with ?breed=maltipu — that breed's base (?breed=general — requests without a breed).
Repeat requests (children) are hidden unless include_children=true.
